name: groundwork
description: Groundwork shared agent tooling: drive-pr runs a pull request's review rounds unattended, do-item works a tracker item through to a pull request, resolve-review-comments settles review threads, the review-arbiter agent rules on contested findings, and procedure skills cover reviewing a change (review), repairing failing CI (fix-ci), GitHub Actions workflows (github-actions), architecture decision records (adr), de-scarring documents (descar), promoting agent memory (promote-memory), bulk read-only analysis (programmatic-execution), design briefs (design-brief-builder), settling technical dilemmas with cited decision sheets (decide) and cited explainer sheets of how a system works (explain). Each repository supplies its own values in .config/groundwork-overlay.yaml.
